comparisons.peer_topic: Assumption and Terms of Xilinx Notes
comparisons.peer_summary: The Company assumed $1.5 billion in aggregate principal of Xilinx's 2.950% Notes due 2024 and 2.375% Notes due 2030, recorded at fair value on the acquisition date, as general unsecured senior obligations with semi-annual interest payments.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and AMD disclose the assumption of senior unsecured notes from acquired entities (VMware for AVGO, Xilinx for AMD). AVGO assumed $8,250 million of VMware's notes, while AMD assumed $1.5 billion of Xilinx's notes. Both disclosures characterize these assumed obligations as general unsecured senior obligations.

sentences.text: In connection with the VMware Merger, we assumed $8,250 million of VMware's outstanding senior unsecured notes.

In connection with the acquisition of Xilinx, the Company assumed $1.5 billion in aggregate principal of Xilinx's 2.950% Notes due 2024 and 2.375% Notes due 2030 (together, the Assumed Xilinx Notes) which were recorded at fair value as of the Xilinx Acquisition Date.
The Assumed Xilinx Notes are general unsecured senior obligations of the Company with semi-annual fixed interest payments due on June 1 and December 1.
